printedVariants.Variant: Diseased Giant Rats: CR 1/8 (25 XP). Replace the standard Bite with this version. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit with 5-ft. reach against one target. Hit for 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage. A creature hit must pass a DC 10 Constitution save or contract a disease. While infected, the creature can regain HP only through magic and its HP maximum drops by 3 (1d6) every 24 hours. If this disease brings its maximum HP to 0, the creature dies.

firstPrinting.source: First-print bound Monster Manual spot check and official errata v2.0, p. 1.

mechanicsNotes: Page 327 supplies the variant in its own sidebar. The 2018 Basic Rules prints the default entry on p. 135.
The variant does not state a repeat save, natural recovery interval or a timing rule for restoring the lost hit point maximum after a cure.
